title: Sr. Engineer / Asst. Manager
jobDescription:
Xylem is a Fortune 500 global water solutions company dedicated to advancing sustainable impact and empowering the people who make water work every day. As a leading water technology company with 23,000 employees operating in over 150 countries, Xylem is at the forefront of addressing the world's most critical water challenges. We invite passionate individuals to join our team, dedicated to exceeding customer expectations through innovative and sustainable solutions. Job Summary: The Production Jr. Supervisor is responsible for overseeing a team of analysts and technicians to ensure that production standards are consistently met. This role involves coordinating daily production activities, conducting audits and inspections, and providing guidance and support to team members. The Jr. Supervisor works closely with the Production Supervisor and other department leaders to develop and implement production improvement initiatives. Key responsibilities include monitoring performance metrics, addressing nonconformance, and ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Inventory Management: • Monitor and track inventory levels • Order supplies and materials as needed • Implement systems to optimize inventory management • Conduct regular inventory audits to ensure accuracy and identify discrepancies • Coordinate with purchasing department to ensure timely delivery of materials Safety and Compliance: • Enforce safety protocols and procedures • Conduct regular safety training for production team members • Ensure compliance with all relevant regulations and guidelines • Conduct safety inspections and address any safety concerns or hazards • Maintain accurate and up-to-date safety records. Team Mentorship: • Empowerment: Mentor junior team members, fostering their growth and skill development. • Collaboration: Work closely with cross functional teams to align processes and achieve goals. High Impact Behaviors: • Leadership by Example: Supervisors should model the behavior they expect from their team. This includes demonstrating a strong work ethic, integrity, and commitment to the organization’s values. • Team Engagement and Development: Supervisors need to actively engage their team members, recognizing their strengths and providing opportunities for skill development. This also involves offering constructive feedback and fostering a supportive team environment. • Operational Efficiency: Supervisors should strive for continuous improvement in processes, ensuring that the team works efficiently and effectively. This includes setting clear goals, monitoring progress, and adapting strategies as necessary.

QUALIFICATIONS:
• A bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, or a related field with at least 2 years experience or equivalent work experience that provides exposure to fundamental theories, principles, and concepts. • Strong analytical skills and proficiency in data analysis tools (e.g., Excel, SQL). • In-depth understanding of inventory management principles and practices. • Experience with inventory management software and systems. • Ability to develop and implement inventory optimization strategies. • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. • Ability to work independently and as part of a team. • Good understanding of international trade laws and customs regulations. Join the global Xylem team to be a part of innovative technology solutions transforming water usage, conservation, and re-use. Our products impact public utilities, industrial sectors, residential areas, and commercial buildings, with a commitment to providing smart metering, network technologies, and advanced analytics for water, electric, and gas utilities. Partner with us in creating a world where water challenges are met with ingenuity and dedication; where we recognize the power of inclusion and belonging in driving innovation and allowing us to compete more effectively around the world. title: Sr. Service Engineer- UV
jobDescription: Xylem is a Fortune 500 global water solutions company dedicated to advancing sustainable impact and empowering the people who make water work every day. As a leading water technology company with 23,000 employees operating in over 150 countries, Xylem is at the forefront of addressing the world's most critical water challenges. We invite passionate individuals to join our team, dedicated to exceeding customer expectations through innovative and sustainable solutions. Key Responsibilities Installation & Commissioning Perform installation, commissioning, and start-up of UV disinfection systems at customer locations. Verify equipment installation as per engineering drawings, specifications, and safety standards. Configure and test electrical, mechanical, and control system components. Conduct performance validation and operational checks during project handover. Provide customer training on operation and routine maintenance of UV systems. Service & Maintenance Execute preventive and corrective maintenance activities for UV equipment. Diagnose and troubleshoot electrical, mechanical, instrumentation, and control-related issues. Replace and repair faulty components including lamps, ballasts, sensors, actuators, power supplies, motors, pumps, valves, and control panels. Perform system inspections and recommend corrective actions to improve equipment reliability. Maintain service records and submit detailed service reports after each site visit. Electro-Mechanical Support Troubleshoot and maintain: UV reactors and chambers Electrical control panels PLC-based control systems Sensors and instrumentation Pumps and motors Actuated valves Power distribution systems Wiring and cable connections Interpret electrical schematics, GA drawings, wiring diagrams, and P&ID drawings. Conduct electrical measurements using testing instruments such as multimeters, insulation testers, and clamp meters. Customer Support Provide on-site and remote technical support to customers. Respond promptly to service calls and breakdown situations. Coordinate with customers regarding service schedules, spare parts requirements, and system upgrades. Ensure high customer satisfaction through timely issue resolution. Documentation & Reporting Prepare installation, commissioning, troubleshooting, and maintenance reports. Maintain service logs, visit reports, and equipment history records. Submit travel expenses, service documentation, and customer feedback reports on time. Assist in preparing technical service manuals and maintenance procedures. Safety & Compliance Follow company EHS guidelines and customer site safety requirements. Conduct risk assessments before carrying out field activities. title: Global Service Delivery – Invoice to Pay Team Leader
jobDescription:
Xylem is a Fortune 500 global water solutions company dedicated to advancing sustainable impact and empowering the people who make water work every day. As a leading water technology company with 23,000 employees operating in over 150 countries, Xylem is at the forefront of addressing the world's most critical water challenges. We invite passionate individuals to join our team, dedicated to exceeding customer expectations through innovative and sustainable solutions. Essential Duties/Principal Responsibilities Manage team to process supplier invoices through Coupa (Rossum/ CSP / 2-way & 3-way matching) or SAP for specific requirement (ex: Intercompany transaction) Ensure team validate invoice details against Purchase Orders and Goods Receipts Support team to resolve exceptions such as price variance, quantity mismatch, duplicate invoices Manage team responsible for posting non-PO invoices using approved workflows in Coupa Ensure team transfer and post approved invoices into SAP S/4HANA (FI module) Ensure correct application of GST (IGST, CGST, SGST) and TDS deductions or other specifications from local countries Make sure team validate tax codes during invoice posting in SAP Support audit requirements (internal/external) Follow SOX and internal control procedures in S2P environment Handles complex, high-value and multi-line invoices Handles international and multi-currency invoices Works independently with minimal supervision Resolves 90–100% issues independently Identify process improvements Uses professional judgement Acts proactively and anticipates issues Provide support to suppliers on: Invoice submission via Coupa Supplier Portal Payment status and remittance advice Documentation requirements Liaise with Procurement and Business users to resolve invoice holds or other issues Monitor and work toward improving AP KPIs such as: Invoice cycle time First-pass yield Touchless processing rate On-time payment % Low error rate (<1–2%) Assist with month-end closing activities and reconciliation Support continuous improvement initiatives

MINIMUM

QUALIFICATIONS:

Education, Experience, Skills, Abilities, License/Certification: Bachelor’s degree in commerce, accounting, or finance 6 –10+ years’ experience in Accounts Payable Hands-on experience with Coupa S2P and SAP S/4HANA Strong understanding of GST & TDS compliance and Americas nuances Good communication skills (English) Experience working in a Global Shared Services Centre Knowledge of SOX and internal controls Prior experience in high-volume invoice environment High attention to detail Strong time-management Process improvement mindset Problem-solving ability Customer-service orientation Ability to work with tight deadlines Manage high volumes of transaction Advanced oral, written, and interpersonal communication skills. Strong presentation and facilitation skills to communicate with and persuade a wide range of audiences. Preferred – Finance and or Procurement background Physical Demands (The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.) Work is conducted in an office environment. Regularly required to sit, stand, walk, reach with hands and arms, and move about the facility. Ability to use hands and fingers dexterously to operate office equipment. Regularly required to listen, talk to, and see employees daily via Teams or Online application. Vision abilities required by this job include close vision. Work Environment (The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.) Office: Standard office equipment; work performed in an office setting free from any disagreeable elements. Standard weekly job hours: 40 hours / 5 days of week This requires the employee to work onsite three days per week (Tuesday to Thursday) This role operates within a two-shift structure (9:00 AM – 6:00 PM IST and 12:00 PM – 9:00 PM IST) to support North America. The specific shift assignment will be determined during the recruitment and selection process, and the successful candidate will be expected to work in one of the assigned shifts. For employees assigned to the Late Shift (12:00 PM – 9:00 PM IST), Xylem will provide company-arranged transportation from the workplace to the employee’s home to ensure safety. This position would be in Xylem Bangalore Office (Karle Town Center). Xylem is an Equal Opportunity Employer. title: Graduate Engineer Trainee
jobDescription:
Xylem is a Fortune 500 global water solutions company dedicated to advancing sustainable impact and empowering the people who make water work every day. As a leading water technology company with 23,000 employees operating in over 150 countries, Xylem is at the forefront of addressing the world's most critical water challenges. We invite passionate individuals to join our team, dedicated to exceeding customer expectations through innovative and sustainable solutions. Job Summary: GCC Vadodara campus seeks to hire Graduate Engineer Trainee (GET) / LCA Analyst who can contribute to the growth of Xylem's Global Capability Center and its expansion into sustainable technology and business solutions. The selected candidate will be responsible for conducting life cycle assessments for our global product development teams. If you are excited and passionate, we want to hear from you! Principal

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Support Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) studies through data collection, modeling, and analysis. Collect, organize, and maintain product, manufacturing, and environmental data. Assist in preparing LCA reports, Product Sustainability Reports (PSRs) and Environmental Product Declarations (EPDs). Work with cross-functional teams to gather products and process information. Learn and use LCA software tools such as Sima Pro or equivalent. Ensure data accuracy, documentation and compliance with internal quality standards. Stay updated on sustainability standards, LCA methodologies and industry best practices Required

QUALIFICATIONS:
Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Environmental, Chemical, Industrial, Production Engineering or a related discipline. 0–1 year of experience (Freshers are encouraged to apply). Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Power Point. Team Management: • Understand team dynamics and effective management practices. title: Senior Mechanical Design Engineer
jobDescription:
Xylem is a Fortune 500 global water solutions company dedicated to advancing sustainable impact and empowering the people who make water work every day. As a leading water technology company with 23,000 employees operating in over 150 countries, Xylem is at the forefront of addressing the world's most critical water challenges. We invite passionate individuals to join our team, dedicated to exceeding customer expectations through innovative and sustainable solutions. Job Summary: The Senior Mechanical Engineer is responsible for design and development of Water and Wastewater products. This role involves working Independently with the little guidance of experienced engineers, conducting research, analyzing data, and contributing to the optimization of production processes.

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Create 3D models and CAD drawings of engineered products / process equipment, including creation of general arrangement, assembly and fabrication drawings. Conversion of 2D Drawings to 3D Models, modify, improve, and reverse engineering of existing designs and products. Experience in working with i-Factories and i-Properties of 3D Model files. Create and update Meta-Data of designs and 3D models in PDM/PLM system (Vault Pro) for records, control and retrieval. Completion of Meta-Data of 3D Model files to get to a “release” ready status. Create Bills of Materials (BOMs) in enterprise resource planning (ERP / SAP) system. Design and detailing of Water and Wastewater Treatment Products like Bio-Mag, Co-Mag, Pressure Sand filters, Self-Cleaning filters, Hydro-Cyclones, In-take screens, Filter Press, Clarifiers, Thickeners, Orbal, etc., Checking the General Arrangement Drawing, Fabrication Drawing and Field Connection Drawings and ensuring the Design and quality requirements. Perform Root Cause Analysis of design / dimensional errors and bring out corrective action. Prepare ECN (Engineering Change Notice) or DCN (Design Change Notice) and coordinate to complete the process. Review and continuously improve the existing modeling approach to reduce the modeling / design execution time. Cross functional interaction / coordination to ensure product / equipment design meeting the complete technical requirement. Collaborate with Project Engineers to address technical requirements and coordinate with global team to address design queries. Academic and Professional Requirements: BE / B Tech in Mechanical Engineering with First Class. 6 to 10 years of hands of experience in 3D CAD using Autodesk Inventor. Exposure in Auto CAD will be an added advantage but not a must. Exposure in Autodesk VAULT or equivalent software for PDM. Candidates who have worked in Water Treatment Industries, Effluent Treatment Plant are preferable Experience in equipment / product design and detail engineering with fair knowledge of material specification, fabrication detailing is preferred. Experience in design & detail engineering (preparation of GA, Fabrication drawings, BOM etc.,) of Bio-Mag, Co-Mag, Pressure Sand filters, Self-Cleaning filters, Hydro-Cyclones, In-take screens, Filter Press, Clarifiers, Thickeners, Orbal, etc., are preferred. Experience in equipment design and detail engineering in the domain of Water and Wastewater Treatment is preferred or similar experience in Oil & Gas, Chemical process and Power plants can be considered. Exposure to MS Office package for preparing necessary documents, excel files and ppt’s will be an advantage. Experience in working with international teams in engineering design will be an advantage. Good communication skills to liaise with international teams; Extra miler / self-driven to meet the commitments / goals. Be analytical and problem solving. jobDescription:

Overview of Xylem Xylem (XYL) is a leading global water technology company committed to developing innovative technology solutions to the world’s water challenges. The Company’s products and services move, treat, analyze, monitor and return water to the environment in public utility, industrial, residential and commercial building services settings. Xylem also provides a leading portfolio of smart metering, network technologies and advanced infrastructure analytics solutions for water, electric and gas utilities. The Company’s more than 23000 employees bring broad applications expertise with a strong focus on identifying comprehensive, sustainable solutions. Headquarter in Rye Brook, New York with 2023 revenue of $8.1 billion, Xylem does business in more than 150 countries through a number of market-leading product brands. The name Xylem is derived from classical Greek and is the tissue that transports water in plants, highlighting the engineering efficiency of our water-centric business by linking it with the best water transportation of all – that which occurs in nature. For more information, please visit us at www.xylem.com. Overview of Growth Center: Global Capability Center (GCC) helps Growth centers of Xylem such as AWS, Treatment and Analytics in wide range of activities that include New Product Development, Value Engineering, Sustain Engineering and Software development. We partner with them to anticipate and respond to evolving business needs with innovation in sensing and communications technologies, data analytics and services. Brief Description/Job Summary: Mechanical Design Engineer GCC Vadodara campus seeks to hire a Mechanical Design Engineer who can contribute to the growth of Xylem's India Technology Center and its expansion into disruptive technology and business solutions. The position involves playing a key role in advancing Xylem water treatment technology capabilities. This position plays a vital role in supporting Xylem’s water treatment projects by providing high-quality mechanical design and engineering deliverables. The role focuses on order engineering activities such as design, submittal preparation, and fabrication drawings to ensure accurate, timely, and cost-effective execution of customer projects. Good to Have: Knowledge of piping/structural design and GD&T. Knowledge about UV, aeration and wastewater treatment systems Experience with water/wastewater projects and OEM environments. Familiarity with engineering submittals, fabrication processes, and shop drawings. Strong communication and collaboration skills across teams and regions.

title: Sr. Product Security Engineer
jobDescription: Xylem is a Fortune 500 global water solutions company dedicated to advancing sustainable impact and empowering the people who make water work every day. As a leading water technology company with 23,000 employees operating in over 150 countries, Xylem is at the forefront of addressing the world's most critical water challenges. We invite passionate individuals to join our team, dedicated to exceeding customer expectations through innovative and sustainable solutions. Welcome to Xylem Xylem (NYSE: XYL) is a Fortune 500 global water technology company with 23,000 employees operating in over 150 countries. Our purpose is clear: to empower our customers and communities to build a more water-secure world. Xylem's solutions are active in water systems that treat, transport, test, and monitor water for hundreds of millions of people. Since 2019, Xylem technology has helped customers reuse more than 18 billion cubic meters of water, reduce water loss across distribution networks, and protect communities from contamination and flood events. Water security is becoming one of the defining technology challenges of the next decade. The rapid growth of AI infrastructure, data centers, semiconductor fabrication, and advanced power generation is placing significant new demands on water systems worldwide. Xylem is working with utilities, industry, and technology companies to ensure water infrastructure can support the demands of a changing economy while remaining resilient for the communities that depend on it. As Xylem scales its digital and AI-enabled product portfolio, the security of those systems becomes directly connected to that mission. The products and platforms this team is responsible for are operational systems that utilities, municipalities, and industrial operators rely on to manage water safely and efficiently. Your New Role We are looking for an experienced Product Security Engineer to join our Global Product Security Engineering team in India. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who has moved beyond operating tools and is ready to function as a trusted contributor to a team that works closely with product and engineering organizations. Product security at Xylem is focused on enabling informed, risk-based decisions. We work alongside engineering, architecture, and product leadership to understand what is being built, where the meaningful risk lives, and how to address it in ways that fit the business context. The assessments and findings you produce will feed directly into those decisions, giving the people who own them the technical clarity they need to act with confidence. The primary focus of this role is security assessment of cloud-hosted applications and APIs. As the portfolio continues to grow and AI-enabled products become a larger part of what Xylem delivers, the team's ability to assess those systems rigorously is increasingly important. This role sits at the center of that work. Your Role Responsibilities Lead security assessments of cloud-hosted applications and APIs, grounded in a thorough understanding of the application's business logic, threat model, and architecture. Assess modern identity and access control implementations, including OAuth2/OIDC, SAML, and JWT, with the ability to reason about design-level weaknesses. Produce assessment reports that give engineering and product leadership the context they need to make sound, risk-based decisions. Work directly with engineering and product teams through the resolution process, applying the judgment needed to evaluate whether a proposed control genuinely reduces risk. Conduct threat modeling and architecture reviews early in the design process, helping teams understand the security implications of their choices. Contribute to the standards, assessment methodologies, and tooling that define how product security work is conducted across the portfolio. Support the product security incident response function (PSIRT) as needed, helping teams understand the significance of externally reported security issues and supporting coordinated disclosure. Stay current on application, API, and AI security developments and bring that knowledge back to the team in ways the team can use. What We Are Looking For We are looking for a practitioner with demonstrated experience and a proven track record in product or application security. The right person has done this work as a core responsibility, not a secondary one, and can speak with authority about what they have assessed, what they found, and how they helped the business respond. Demonstrated hands-on experience in product security or application security, with a track record of conducting thorough security assessments of cloud-hosted applications and APIs. We are looking for people who have owned engagements. A strong foundation in how web applications and APIs fail from a security standpoint, including the classes of weakness covered by the OWASP Top 10 and OWASP API Security Top 10, and the judgment to recognize when those frameworks apply and when they require adaptation. Experience assessing modern identity and access control implementations, including OAuth2/OIDC, SAML, and JWT, at both the design level and the implementation level. The ability to write proof-of-concept code to demonstrate the real-world impact of a finding, supported by enough scripting ability to extend and automate your own assessment work. Working knowledge of cloud-hosted architectures, microservices, and container-based deployments, with the ability to reason about where security assumptions are most likely to hold and where they are most likely to fail. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce clear, well-reasoned assessment reports for a technical audience. The ability to build effective working relationships with engineering and product teams, including the confidence to advocate for a different course when the risk warrants it. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Security, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. What Would Set You Apart Every strong candidate brings something the job description did not anticipate. The following are examples of experience that would be differentiating in this role, but they are not the full picture. If you have depth in an area that is not listed here and believe it is relevant, we want to hear about it. Experience assessing AI-enabled products in production, including LLM integrations, retrieval augmented generation systems, agents, tool calling, and model endpoints. This is an emerging and strategically important area for Xylem's portfolio, and the ability to assess it rigorously is a meaningful differentiator. Familiarity with emerging AI security frameworks and guidance, including the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, and MITRE ATLAS, applied critically rather than as a checklist. Strong automation, scripting, or development capability beyond the basics. If you build tools to extend your own assessments, automate repeatable work, or prototype solutions because nothing off the shelf fits the problem, that is the kind of initiative we want to know about. Experience with embedded systems, Io T, firmware analysis, or hardware-adjacent attack surface assessment. Xylem's product portfolio extends well below the application layer, and the ability to work lower in the stack adds real value. Experience with threat modeling methods such as STRIDE and integrating security thinking into software development at the design stage. Experience communicating security risk to diverse stakeholders, including product leadership and non-technical audiences, in ways that support informed decision-making. Relevant certifications such as OSCP, GWAPT, GWEB, or equivalent that reflect a commitment to the craft . How We Get Things Done Xylem's Global Product Security Engineering team functions as a trusted resource to the business. We are embedded in the product development process, not adjacent to it. We spend as much time understanding what we are assessing as conducting the assessment itself, because context is what makes the output useful to the people acting on it. Your New Role We are looking for an experienced Product Security Engineer to join our Global Product Security Engineering team in India. This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who has moved beyond operating tools and is ready to function as a trusted contributor to a team that works closely with product and engineering organizations. Product security at Xylem is focused on enabling informed, risk-based decisions. We work alongside engineering, architecture, and product leadership to understand what is being built, where the meaningful risk lives, and how to address it in ways that fit the business context. The primary focus of this role is security assessment of cloud-hosted applications and APIs. This role sits at the center of that work. Your Role Responsibilities Lead security assessments of cloud-hosted applications and APIs, grounded in a thorough understanding of the application's business logic, threat model, and architecture. Assess modern identity and access control implementations, including OAuth2/OIDC, SAML, and JWT, with the ability to reason about design-level weaknesses. Stay current on application, API, and AI security developments and bring that knowledge back to the team in ways the team can use. The right person has done this work as a core responsibility, not a secondary one, and can speak with authority about what they have assessed, what they found, and how they helped the business respond. Demonstrated hands-on experience in product security or application security, with a track record of conducting thorough security assessments of cloud-hosted applications and APIs. We are looking for people who have owned engagements. A strong foundation in how web applications and APIs fail from a security standpoint, including the classes of weakness covered by the OWASP Top 10 and OWASP API Security Top 10, and the judgment to recognize when those frameworks apply and when they require adaptation. Experience assessing modern identity and access control implementations, including OAuth2/OIDC, SAML, and JWT, at both the design level and the implementation level. The ability to write proof-of-concept code to demonstrate the real-world impact of a finding, supported by enough scripting ability to extend and automate your own assessment work. Working knowledge of cloud-hosted architectures, microservices, and container-based deployments, with the ability to reason about where security assumptions are most likely to hold and where they are most likely to fail. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce clear, well-reasoned assessment reports for a technical audience. The ability to build effective working relationships with engineering and product teams, including the confidence to advocate for a different course when the risk warrants it. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Security, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. What Would Set You Apart Every strong candidate brings something the job description did not anticipate. The following are examples of experience that would be differentiating in this role, but they are not the full picture. Experience assessing AI-enabled products in production, including LLM integrations, retrieval augmented generation systems, agents, tool calling, and model endpoints. This is an emerging and strategically important area for Xylem's portfolio, and the ability to assess it rigorously is a meaningful differentiator. Familiarity with emerging AI security frameworks and guidance, including the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, and MITRE ATLAS, applied critically rather than as a checklist. Strong automation, scripting, or development capability beyond the basics. jobDescription: Xylem is a Fortune 500 global water solutions company dedicated to advancing sustainable impact and empowering the people who make water work every day. About the Role (Role Purpose) The Central VAVE team works across Xylem segments and product lines to deliver annualized cost savings through structured VAVE methodology. The Senior VAVE Engineer will lead end-to-end VAVE projects focused on pump assemblies and components (hydraulics, castings, rotating parts, housings, mechanical interfaces), partnering with Engineering, Sourcing, Manufacturing, Quality, and Suppliers to generate, validate, and industrialize value ideas. Impact: Drive measurable annualized savings through robust engineering-based VAVE, with a strong focus on pumps, hydraulics, and mechanical design excellence. Key Responsibilities VAVE Delivery & Project Leadership Lead VAVE projects from ideation to implementation with clear charters, savings validation, and timeline ownership. Perform Function Analysis and develop FAST diagrams to identify value opportunities and eliminate non-value-adding cost. Generate and evaluate concepts using structured tools (e.g., functional decomposition, cost drivers, teardown/benchmarking, DFM/DFA). Convert ideas into implementable engineering changes: design updates, drawings, specifications, and validation plans. Pump Domain Engineering (Core) Provide deep technical leadership in pump design & development, including hydraulic components such as impellers, volutes/diffusers, and associated mechanical interfaces. Conduct analytical assessments (performance, structural integrity, fit-up, manufacturability, tolerance stack impacts). Ensure designs meet functional requirements: performance, reliability, manufacturability, serviceability, and compliance. CAD, Drawings, GD&T Create/review 3D models and 2D drawings in PTC Creo; ensure change control and configuration discipline. Interpret and apply GD&T; drive robust tolerancing for manufacturability and quality. Perform drawing reviews and ensure design intent is captured accurately for suppliers and manufacturing. Benchmarking, Cost & Cross-Functional Collaboration Lead benchmarking / teardown activities to compare competitive design and cost structures; translate learnings into actionable VAVE proposals. Collaborate with cost engineering team on should-cost inputs, supplier ideas, and cost breakdown discussions. Able to comprehend cost drivers and focus points for ideation from should cost report out. Work with Manufacturing/Quality to validate process capability, risk, and implementation readiness. Present VAVE findings to leadership with clear ROI, risk mitigation plans, and implementation roadmap. Required Qualifications (Must Have) Experience 10+ years of industry experience with strong focus on pump design and development (centrifugal / mixed flow / axial, as applicable). Demonstrated hands-on expertise in VAVE tools and processes, with Function Analysis and FAST diagram development as core strengths. Technical Skills Strong pump domain knowledge, including hydraulic components (e.g., impellers, volutes/diffusers) and associated mechanical design considerations. Strong Mechanical Engineering fundamentals (mechanics, machine design, materials, manufacturing basics, tolerance stack concepts). Excellent drawing reading skills with solid GD&T application and interpretation. Proven experience using Creo (PTC Creo) for 3D modeling and 2D drawings. Strong analytical/problem-solving skills; ability to validate concepts using calculations, data, and engineering judgment. Education & Academic Criteria (Screening) 10th and 12th: Minimum 70% aggregate (or equivalent grading). Full-time BE/BTech (Mechanical or equivalent) from a recognized institute/university, 7CGPA. Preferred education path: 12th → Engineering degree (candidates with diploma route are not preferred for this role). Nice to Have (Preferred) Ability to interpret and apply manufacturing drawings and production documentation. Knowledge of material standards (common pump metals, polymers, coatings) and standardization opportunities. Knowledge of manufacturing processes (casting, machining, welding, sheet metal, injection molding, additive where relevant). Experience with plastic part design (DFM, ribs, drafts, gating considerations, shrink/warp awareness). Strong data analytics skills; experience with Excel (advanced), Power BI, and usage of AI tools for engineering productivity. Experience conducting ideation workshops / Kaizen / VAVE workshops with cross-functional teams. Familiarity with Six Sigma tools (DMAIC, hypothesis testing, capability, FMEA, MSA). Exposure to pressure vessel design fundamentals (codes/standards awareness is a plus). Behavioral Competencies Strong stakeholder management across Engineering, Operations, Quality, and Sourcing. Executive-ready communication—able to defend assumptions, trade-offs, and risks. Bias for action and closure—drives implementation, not just ideas. High learning agility and ability to work across multiple product lines/segments. Structured thinking and documentation discipline. title: Manager
jobDescription:
Xylem is a Fortune 500 global water solutions company dedicated to advancing sustainable impact and empowering the people who make water work every day. As a leading water technology company with 23,000 employees operating in over 150 countries, Xylem is at the forefront of addressing the world's most critical water challenges. We invite passionate individuals to join our team, dedicated to exceeding customer expectations through innovative and sustainable solutions. Reporting to: Head – Application Engineering Business Unit: Xylem – Treatment Role Summary: The Application / Proposal Engineer will be part of the Xylem Treatment team and will be responsible for end‑to‑end proposal and application engineering activities—from bid stage to manufacturing release. The role includes process design, cost estimation, proposal development, and preparation of compliance matrices for industrial and municipal water and wastewater treatment projects, with a strong focus on recycling and reuse applications. Key Responsibilities Proposal & Application Engineering Prepare comprehensive technical and commercial proposals, including proposal outlines and compliance matrices, aligned with customer specifications and tender requirements. Review and analyze industrial and municipal tenders/RFPs to ensure full compliance and responsiveness to client needs. Develop process designs, select appropriate technologies and products, estimate costs, and support timely proposal submission. Create and maintain proposal schedules, conduct proposal progress meetings, and manage bid submission plans including interim and final reviews. Act as the technical expert for membrane-based water and wastewater treatment applications, including UF, RO (BWRO & SWRO), MBR, EDI, and hybrid systems. Analyze feed water characteristics, operating conditions, and customer requirements to develop optimized treatment solutions. Perform system design calculations including: Process & Mass Balance Membrane flux and recovery design Hydraulic calculations Chemical consumption and OPEX estimation Prepare and review technical documents such as Process Flow Diagrams (PFD/HFD), P&IDs, equipment layouts, and datasheets. Support troubleshooting, process optimization, and risk mitigation during proposal and design review stages. Technical Design & Costing Perform process selection, equipment sizing, and application analysis based on project data. Prepare process & mass balance calculations, hydraulic calculations, electrical load lists, instrument lists, OPEX estimates, and cost estimates. Develop technical deliverables such as HFDs, P&IDs, layout sketches, equipment lists, and detailed quotations. Continuously improve process sizing tools and design programs; demonstrate measurable improvements made to these tools. Support technology transfer of new membrane products, tools, and application guidelines from global technology centers to regional teams. Stakeholder Coordination Work closely with Sales, Product Management, R&D,Procurement, Project Management, and Manufacturing to deliver competitive and high‑quality proposals. Support sales teams during technical discussions, clarifications, and presentations with customers. Participate in proposal strategy development and Proposal Management Plan (PMP) preparation. Attend pre‑qualification meetings, design and risk review sessions, and customer meetings as required. Technology Transfer & Knowledge Sharing Participate in commercial and technical technology transfer activities within Xylem, including established and emerging water and wastewater treatment technologies. Support internal teams during conception, detailed engineering, and fabrication phases. Technical Skills & Competencies Comprehensive expertise in industrial water and wastewater treatment technologies, including membrane systems such as UF, BWRO, SWRO, MBR, MB, and EDI. Strong understanding of filtration systems, biological treatment processes, chemical dosing, evaporation, and related unit operations. Demonstrated capability in proposal engineering, cost estimation, and lifecycle cost analysis. In-depth knowledge of the Indian industrial and municipal water and wastewater sectors. Proficient in MS Office applications, with working knowledge of Auto CAD, P&ID development, and process simulation tools. Solid analytical, organizational, and project coordination abilities. Excellent technical writing, documentation, presentation, and communication skills in English. Familiarity with global engineering standards and bidding practices commonly followed by membrane OEMs and EPC organizations. Proven experience working within matrix organizations and collaborating with multidisciplinary, global teams. Experience & Industry Exposure Minimum 15 years of experience in proposal engineering or application engineering within the industrial water and wastewater treatment sector, particularly recycling and reuse projects. Exposure to industries including Oil & Gas, Refineries, Chemicals, Food & Beverage, Power, Pharmaceuticals, Textiles, CETPs, Paper & Pulp, and similar sectors. Prior experience with reputed EPCs or water technology companies, reputed membrane OEMs or system integrators is highly desirable. Behavioral Attributes Self‑driven, organized, and accountable. Results‑oriented with a strong focus on technical problem solving. Able to work effectively in multidisciplinary teams. Capable of working under pressure and meeting tight deadlines with minimal supervision. Qualifications

title: Shift In charge
jobDescription:
Xylem is a Fortune 500 global water solutions company dedicated to advancing sustainable impact and empowering the people who make water work every day. As a leading water technology company with 23,000 employees operating in over 150 countries, Xylem is at the forefront of addressing the world's most critical water challenges. We invite passionate individuals to join our team, dedicated to exceeding customer expectations through innovative and sustainable solutions. Key Responsibilities
1. Shift supervision and team leadership Supervise and coordinate the activities of STP operators, technicians, and helpers on the assigned shift, ensuring smooth handover and clear communication via shift logs. Assign duties, monitor work performance, and take immediate corrective action if any safety or operational standard is not followed.
2. STP process control and monitoring Monitor key STP processes including influent flow, primary treatment, biological treatment (e.g., MBBR/SBR/UASB), sludge handling, and final effluent discharge to ensure compliance with PCB/CPCB‑type norms.
